changelog: Boomboxes carried into a blocked zone now pause and can't be played, skipped or put down there; carry it out and press play to continue
Job-locked DJ sets: everyone with the job can play, pause, skip, change songs and set the volume, no matter who started the song; admins can use them too
Admin Stop fully resets karaoke stages and DJ sets in karaoke mode
Stop and pause are reliable: a song still loading, a song change or a crossfade no longer brings the music back
